import (

func TestEvaluatorComparisons(t *testing.T) {
 assert.NoError(t, validate(constraint{Property: \"active\", Operator: \"TRUE\"}))

 assert.Error(t, err)
 matched, err = matchesBool(constraint{Operator: \"TRUE\"}, \" true \")
 require.NoError(t, err)
 assert.True(t, matched)

}

func TestEvaluatorBucketBoundary(t *testing.T) {
 r := &flipt.EvaluationRequest{FlagKey: \"flag\", EntityId: \"entity\"}

}

 _, err = matchesBool(constraint{Operator: \"TRUE\"}, \"maybe\")
 assert.Error(t, err)
}
